context: Request: which of the firm's M&A deals included a working-capital adjustment, with the purchase agreements. Rubric: 15 qualifying matters (1001-00003 … 1041-00003; 1011-00006 via a draft v1 APA, 1017-00006 via mipa-execution-version.docx, 1041-00003 via merger-agreement-execution-version.docx), each with a proof document, plus a precision criterion (1022-00006, 1023-00001, 1032-00005 not permitted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three whole-store globs by file type (one type has no files).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, memos and an email of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Four store-wide extraction scripts for the request terms: one times out, one prints nothing, then a file list and clause snippets restricted to deal-document folders.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of eight executed or draft agreements picked from the scan output.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six more agreements from the scan output.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction script pulling the term definitions from a named list of agreements.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes seventeen matters, including drafts and deals of other kinds.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The scans listed every qualifying matter; it never opened one of them, and the answer adds three matters outside the set.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The scan output listed documents of one qualifying matter (a redline and a memo, not its agreement), but the agreements it chose to open left that matter out, and it named a sibling matter's draft instead.

other_errors.why: The answer counts three further matters (drafts and other deal types) as qualifying.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for request terms.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Five file-name globs for agreement words; two return nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the first 250-300 lines of agreements and an email from three matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a script lists agreement-named files; a grep over documents and a narrower script both return nothing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six agreements from that file list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over agreement-named files for three exact term phrases; returns 25 files.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the first 15-18 lines of eight agreements in one parallel batch to get parties and dates.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Two snippet-extraction scripts over named agreements for the term definitions.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes twelve agreements; two matters are given the parties of other matters' agreements.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its term scan used three exact phrases over agreement-named files and missed two matters; it skipped a draft it had listed, and attached two matters to other deals' parties.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its main scan looked for three exact phrases only in files with agreement-type names, which missed one matter's executed agreement (other wording) and another's (other file name), and it took the result as complete.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The scan just before listed one matter's draft agreement, but it left that matter out of the agreements it opened and out of the answer.
It paired the eight parallel reads with the wrong matters, so the answer gives two matters the parties of other agreements (evidence seen at [34]-[42]).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements and memos of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads three further sections of one draft agreement.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the request terms; times out after about 1.37M chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six agreements picked from the partial output.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes six matters, one of them outside the set.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its one store-wide scan timed out part-way; it wrote six matters from the partial output, one of them outside the set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its only search was a store-wide scan that timed out after reaching a fraction of the store, and it neither narrowed nor reran it.

other_errors.why: The answer counts a draft agreement of another matter as a qualifying deal.

divergence: The three runs failed differently. T0's scans listed all qualifying matters; it opened all but one and added three matters outside the set (surfaced, never opened; over-inclusion). T1's term scan used narrow phrases over agreement-named files and missed two matters (search miss), skipped a listed draft, and attached two matters to other deals' parties. T2's single store-wide scan timed out and it wrote six matters from the partial output (search miss).
